decks.notes: The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and hand disruption cards. It aims to control the game by efficiently answering threats and preventing the opponent from executing their game plan. The deck also includes card draw and filtering effects to maintain card advantage and find key pieces to further solidify its control over the game. The win conditions are a mix of powerful threats and disruptive creatures that can quickly close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then cascade into Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield for a massive advantage. It utilizes cards like Violent Outburst and Generous Ent to cascade into Living End while also having protection with Force of Negation. Cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder help to fill the graveyard, while cards like Endurance can disrupt the opponent's graveyard strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and quickly close out the game.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and using them to generate mana and card advantage. By utilizing powerful artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga, the deck is able to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of artifact creatures and spells. It also includes disruptive elements like Engineered Explosives and Tormod's Crypt to control the game and hinder the opponent's strategies. By efficiently managing resources and leveraging the synergies between artifacts, the deck aims to aggressively pressure the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing a combination of cheap spells and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By leveraging cards that can deal damage directly to the opponent or to creatures, along with pump spells to increase the damage output of creatures, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells to ensure a consistent stream of threats and answers. The mana base is optimized for fast, consistent casting of spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly amass resources and control the board while also disrupting the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures with powerful artifact synergies and disruptive spells, it aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their game plan. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage, while cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help keep the opponent on their toes. The deck also leverages the land Urza's Saga to generate more artifacts and further strengthen its board presence.

The deck focuses on using graveyard recursion and instant reanimation spells to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to protect key combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. By combining efficient reanimation spells with disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures before they can respond effectively. The key strategy is to carefully manage resources and timing to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in a fast-paced game.

The principle of this deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence through a combination of artifact creatures and artifact-based spells, utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble to generate mana advantage. Key cards such as Urza's Saga, Pinnacle Emissary, and Weapons Manufacturing help to create threats and pressure the opponent quickly, supported by cards like Engineered Explosives for removal and Metallic Rebuke for disruption. Emry, Lurker of the Loch adds recursion and card advantage to keep the pressure on, making this an efficient and dynamic Aggro-Affinity deck in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of colorless mana quickly. It then uses powerful Eldrazi creatures and control spells to dominate the game and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to provide additional utility and control options. Emrakul, the Promised End and other Eldrazi finishers are used to close out the game once control has been established. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and Urza's Saga to generate card advantage and control the game through various disruptive effects. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student offer card selection and recursion, while powerful planeswalkers like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain provide win conditions and additional control tools. The deck also includes a variety of artifacts that synergize with the strategy, such as Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, allowing for quick mana acceleration and card advantage. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while maintaining control of the board.

Utilize instant reanimation spells and combos to bring back powerful creatures like Atraxa and Griselbrand quickly and efficiently, while also controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to set up its graveyard and manipulate its resources to create explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. Through a combination of recursion, card advantage, and disruptive spells, the deck seeks to outpace and outvalue the opponent to secure a victory.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to maintain control with disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize while deploying powerful aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Kozilek's Command to clear the way for its creatures to attack. The inclusion of Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga helps to accelerate the deck's game plan by allowing for quick mana ramp and additional creature token generation. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing ruby-colored spells to generate mana quickly and efficiently in order to cast powerful combo pieces like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wish. By chaining together rituals, card draw, and storm spells, the deck aims to storm off and finish the game with a lethal Grapeshot or a recurring Past in Flames loop. The deck includes tools like Elegant Parlor and Valakut Awakening for additional card selection and manipulation. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a high amount of spells in a single turn to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the Broodscale Bloodchief combo by using creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker along with support cards such as Kozilek's Command and Blade of the Bloodchief. The strategy involves ramping with Eldrazi Temple and using Urza's Saga to search for key pieces. Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER and Emrakul, the Promised End provide additional utility and power. The deck seeks to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the combo for a decisive victory.

This deck focuses on using Goryo's Vengeance to cheat creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play from the graveyard for powerful combo plays. Quantum Riddler helps to dig for combo pieces while Prismatic Ending provides removal. The deck also runs disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces. With cards like Faithful Mending and Ephemerate to cycle through the deck and bring back key creatures, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in explosive fashion.

The deck focuses on aggressively using creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects, such as Flickerwisp and Solitude, in combination with blink effects like Ephemerate to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push to control the board. The deck utilizes a variety of lands to fix mana and ensure consistency. Overall, the strategy revolves around repeatedly blinking creatures to gain advantage and pressure the opponent.

This deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude, while protecting the combo with counterspells like Force of Negation. Instant reanimation is key to the strategy, allowing for explosive plays and unexpected wins. Supporting cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending help to dig for combo pieces and provide additional value. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the game and disrupt the opponent's plans. The synergy between reanimation, protection, and disruption makes this deck a potent threat in the Modern format.
